授業概要
本講義では、半導体ビジネスに関する戦略的な知識を学び、市場で競争力を維持し、成長させるための戦略を考え、日本の半導体産業の現状と課題に対処するための戦略を検討する力を養うことです。また、成功事例と失敗事例から学び、半導体産業の未来に向けたイノベーションと戦略の検討を行います。
In this lecture, students will learn strategic knowledge about the semiconductor business and develop the ability to formulate strategies to maintain and enhance competitiveness in the market. The course also focuses on examining strategies to address the current situation and challenges of Japan's semiconductor industry. Additionally, students will analyze both successful and unsuccessful case studies to explore innovations and strategies for the future of the semiconductor industry.
